memory_root.description: The mission's own directory (memory/missions/<slug>/). Scopes both the read and the enforced write allowlist.

op.description: create: append a new task. set_done: flip an existing task's checkbox. Conditional requiredness of the fields below is enforced by the driver (documented in execution_contract.md), not by this schema.

description.description: Required when op=create. The task line's text (never the raw markdown checkbox syntax).

task_id.description: Required when op=set_done. The task's id exactly as returned by mission.get()/GET /api/missions/{slug} — the 0-indexed line number in plan.md, per aios_core.sdk.mission.MissionStore._parse_tasks. NOT a separate counter.

done.description: Required when op=set_done. The target checkbox state — true=[x], false=[ ]. There is no third state; plan.md's syntax is binary by design (P5).
